title: A linked entry that has a category keeps its own category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations, the test location and location B, so a part can be stocked at location B only.
  • Create a part for this test at location B only, part A, with a category, category A, so part A is not stocked at the test location.
  • Use a different category, category B, from the Category list.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type a description in the Description field.
  3. Type part A's part number in the Part Number field.
  4. Pick category B in the Category field.
  5. Type 10.00 in the Cost field.
  6. Click Save.
  7. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  8. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window opens.

Step 2:

  • Description holds the text.

Step 3:

  • Part Number reads part A's part number.

Step 4:

  • Category reads category B.

Step 5:

  • Cost reads $10.00.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and the part is saved.

Step 7:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 8:

  • Part A's entry still shows category A, not category B.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S7-R6c: “A linked entry with no category takes the one picked in the dialog. An entry that already has a category keeps it.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10820, Chris Ward, 23 Oct 2026: “Please switch to B. When the typed number links to a Part Library entry that has no category, the entry takes the category picked in the dialog, the same way a missing manufacturer is filled (S7-R6b). If the entry already has a category, it keeps its own (S7-R6c).”
